## Engineering Question

How does soft foot affect the repeatability and
accuracy of precision shaft alignment?

## Mechanical Principles

Soft foot occurs when machine feet do not establish
appropriate contact with their mounting surfaces
under defined installation conditions.

Possible contributors include:

- Uneven mounting surfaces
- Improper shimming
- Machine frame distortion
- Mechanical stress during tightening
